news.title: White Horse 3Q FY2026 swings to RM5.051m profit on RM10.0m property disposal gain, but 9M still a RM4.921m net loss

recent_en: WTHORSE announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 19 Nov 2026, swinging to profit in 3Q due to a property disposal gain but remaining in net loss for 9M. The company has also been continuously buying back shares and has a subsidiary in winding-up.
notable_en: 3Q swung to a profit of RM5.051m due to a RM10.0m property disposal gain, but 9M remained a net loss of RM4.921m.
The company has conducted multiple share buybacks recently.
risks_en: 9M still recorded a net loss of RM4.921m.
